# TPC-DI A4

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcdi
```

> [TPC-DI](../../tpc-di.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DI queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  d.CalendarYearID,
  d.CalendarQtrID,
  COUNT(t.TradeID) AS trade_count,
  SUM(t.Quantity * t.TradePrice) AS total_value,
  AVG(t.TradePrice) AS avg_price,
  SUM(t.Fee + t.Commission + t.Tax) AS total_fees
FROM DimDate AS d
JOIN FactTrade AS t
  ON d.SK_DateID = t.SK_CreateDateID
WHERE
  d.CalendarYearID >= 2015 AND d.CalendarYearID <= 2019
GROUP BY
  d.CalendarYearID,
  d.CalendarQtrID
ORDER BY
  d.CalendarYearID,
  d.CalendarQtrID
```
